title: Repository Improvement Effectiveness
description: Sparse owner-bound recurrence, shifted-cost, Evaluation, and residue-retirement result for one completed repository improvement.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for the effectiveness result.

effectiveness_id.description: Stable identity for one admitted effectiveness state.

input_revision.description: Revision of claim, proof, comparable observations, stronger owner, and conclusion.

identity.description: Stable signal, action, execution, proof, and later-observation links.

claim.description: Expected benefit, shifted-cost dimension, comparable task shape, and later-use requirement.

implementation_proof.description: Present-tense proof kept separate from the later operability claim.

signal_state.description: Existing improvement-signal lifecycle state implied by the conclusion.

disposition.description: Retain, refine, promote, revert, dismiss, or retire consequence.

owner.description: Source owner receiving recurrence or retirement consequences.

next_action.description: One bounded next action or retirement transition.

human_visibility.description: Whether unresolved or worsening pressure must be visible without polling.

comparable_observation_count.description: Privacy-safe later observations admitted as task-shape comparable.

rejected_raw_context_observation_count.description: Observations rejected because they contain raw prompt, transcript, or message context.

evaluation_definition.description: Existing Evaluation definition when later use is genuinely required; empty for deterministic or terminal outcomes.

residue.description: Signal, Planning, review, Memory, and counterexample rationale retirement plan.

recurring_context_required.description: False when mature success or stronger-owner state should disappear from recurring context.

ordinary_projection.description: Compact unresolved/worsening owner route; empty after mature terminal retirement.

rule.description: Invariant separating present proof, later Evaluation, and retirement.
